name: Parsley

basicInfo.description: Parsley is a hardy biennial herb commonly grown for its fresh leaves. It grows slowly at first but produces for many months once established.
whyGrow: Cold tolerant and easy to grow
basicInfo.sunlight: 4-6 hours of direct sun or partial shade
basicInfo.water: Water regularly, keep soil moist but not soggy

growingSteps: Sow seeds 1 cm deep in moist soil
Harvest leaves regularly to encourage new growth

careCalendar.description: Soak seeds overnight, then plant directly in soil.
Pick a few outer leaves without damaging the center.
Cut outer leaves to keep plant producing.

causes: Parsley seeds naturally slow to germinate
solutions: Be patient, germination can take 3 weeks

harvestingGuide: Harvest parsley by cutting outer leaves first. Always leave the inner stems to grow. Continuous harvesting encourages more leaves.
estimatedSavings: Growing parsley at home can save $30–40 per year, as store-bought bunches cost $3–4 and spoil quickly.
